            logger.debug("%s /domains/sources status_code=%s", self._LOG_PREFIX, status_code)

            sources_list = list(dict.fromkeys([
                str(x).strip() for x in sources_list if isinstance(x, str) and str(x).strip()
            ]))

            if not sources_list:
                logger.warning("%s Пустой ответ от /domains/sources", self._LOG_PREFIX)
            else:
                logger.debug(
                    "%s Загружено %d источников: %s",
                    self._LOG_PREFIX,
                    len(sources_list),
                    sources_list,
                )

            cfg["options"] = sources_list

            current_value = cfg.get("value")
            if isinstance(current_value, str) and current_value:
                current_value = current_value.strip()
                if current_value not in sources_list:
                    cfg["value"] = ""
                else:
                    cfg["value"] = current_value

        except Exception as e:
            logger.exception("%s Ошибка загрузки источников: %s", self._LOG_PREFIX, str(e))
            cfg["options"] = []
            cfg["value"] = ""

        build_config["arag_source_name"] = cfg
        return build_config

    def update_build_config(
        self, build_config: dotdict, field_value: Any, field_name: str | None = None
    ) -> dotdict:
        if field_name == "rag_type":
            try:
                logger.debug("%s Переключение типа RAG на: %s", self._LOG_PREFIX, field_value)
                self._get_default_view(build_config)

                if field_value == self.RAGTypesEnum.ARAG.value:
                    self._get_arag_view(build_config)
                    system_id_cfg = build_config.get("system_id_input") or {}
                    system_id_value = system_id_cfg.get("value") if isinstance(system_id_cfg, dict) else None
                    self._sync_arag_sources(build_config, system_id_raw=system_id_value)
                elif field_value == self.RAGTypesEnum.DPA.value:
                    for field in ["arag_source_name", "arag_domain_id", "arag_multi_domain", "arag_domain_prefix"]:
                        build_config.pop(field, None)
                    self._get_dpa_view(build_config)
            except Exception:
                logger.exception("%s Ошибка при переключении типа RAG: %s", self._LOG_PREFIX, field_value)
            return build_config

        if field_name == "arag_multi_domain":
            is_multi = bool(field_value)
            cfg = build_config.get("arag_domain_prefix") or {}
            cfg["advanced"] = not is_multi
            build_config["arag_domain_prefix"] = cfg
            return build_config

        if field_name == "system_id_input":
            rag_type_cfg = build_config.get("rag_type") or {}
            current_rag_type = (
                rag_type_cfg.get("value")
                if isinstance(rag_type_cfg, dict)
                else getattr(self, "rag_type", self.RAGTypesEnum.ARAG.value)
            )
            if not current_rag_type:
                current_rag_type = self.RAGTypesEnum.ARAG.value
            if current_rag_type == self.RAGTypesEnum.ARAG.value:
                return self._sync_arag_sources(build_config, system_id_raw=field_value)
            return build_config

        return build_config

    def _get_alfagen_params(self) -> AlfaGenParams:
        try:
            alfagen_params = AlfaGenParams.get_alfagen_params_from_component(self)
            alfagen_params.source_channel_id = SourceChannelEnum.AM_CHAT.value.source_channel_id
            return alfagen_params
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("%s Не удалось получить AlfaGenParams", self._LOG_PREFIX)
            raise

    def _get_text_value(self, attr_name: str) -> str:
        raw = getattr(self, attr_name, None)
        if hasattr(raw, "text"):
            raw = raw.text
        elif isinstance(raw, dict):
            raw = raw.get("text")
        return str(raw).strip() if raw else ""

    def _resolve_system_id(self) -> str:
        manual_value = str(getattr(self, "system_id_input", "") or "").strip()
        if manual_value:
            logger.debug("%s system_id взят из system_id_input", self._LOG_PREFIX)
            return manual_value

        graph_context = getattr(getattr(self, "graph", None), "context", None) or {}
        graph_value = str(graph_context.get("source_channel_id") or "").strip()
        if graph_value:
            logger.debug("%s system_id взят из graph.context.source_channel_id", self._LOG_PREFIX)
            return graph_value

        logger.debug("%s system_id не найден, используется 'undefined'", self._LOG_PREFIX)
        return "undefined"

    @staticmethod
    def _parse_domain_ids(raw_value: str) -> list[int | str]:
        text = str(raw_value).strip()
        if not text:
            return []

        if text.startswith("[") and text.endswith("]"):
            text = text[1:-1].strip()

        parts = [part.strip() for part in text.split(",")] if "," in text else [text]
        return [int(part) if part.isdigit() else part for part in parts if part]

    def _build_arag_filters(self) -> dict | None:
        filters: dict = {}

        source = getattr(self, "arag_source_name", None)
        if isinstance(source, dict):
            source = source.get("value")

        if isinstance(source, str) and source.strip():
            filters["sources"] = [{"name": source.strip()}]

        is_multi_domain = bool(getattr(self, "arag_multi_domain", False))
        if is_multi_domain:
            domain_raw = self._get_text_value("arag_domain_id")
            prefix = self._get_text_value("arag_domain_prefix")
            graph_context = getattr(getattr(self, "graph", None), "context", None) or {}
            os_version = str(graph_context.get("os_version") or "").strip()

            if prefix and os_version:
                domain_raw = f"{prefix}_{os_version}"
            else:
                logger.warning(
                    "%s os_version или префикс отсутствуют, используется дефолтный домен: %s",
                    self._LOG_PREFIX,
                    domain_raw,
                )

            if domain_raw:
                filters["domains"] = [{"id": int(domain_raw) if str(domain_raw).isdigit() else str(domain_raw)}]
        else:
            domain_values = self._parse_domain_ids(self._get_text_value("arag_domain_id"))
            if domain_values:
                filters["domains"] = [{"id": domain_id} for domain_id in domain_values]

        snapshot_filters = filters or None
        logger.debug(
            "%s Собраны ARAG filters: multi_domain=%s, has_source=%s, has_domain=%s, filters=%s",
            self._LOG_PREFIX,
            is_multi_domain,
            bool(filters.get("sources")),
            bool(filters.get("domains")),
            snapshot_filters,
        )
        return snapshot_filters

    async def get_response_from_arag(self) -> ARAGResponse:
        alfagen_params = self._get_alfagen_params()
        query_text = self._get_text_value("query_input")
        system_id = self._resolve_system_id()
        if not query_text:
            raise ValueError("query обязателен")

        filters = self._build_arag_filters()

        logger.debug(
            "%s Запрос к ARAG: system_id=%s, query_len=%d, filters=%s",
            self._LOG_PREFIX,
            system_id,
            len(query_text),
            filters,
        )

        trace_name = "RAG ARAG"

        with trace_component(
            trace_name,
            input_data={"query_len": len(query_text)},
            obj=self,
            trace_kind="rag_request",
            rag_type="arag",
        ) as comp:
            try:
                arag_response = await self.rag_client.arag_gateway_get_chunks(
                    system_id=system_id,
                    user_id=getattr(alfagen_params, "user_id", None),
                    query=query_text,
                    filters=filters,
                )
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.exception("%s Ошибка ARAG gateway", self._LOG_PREFIX)
                try:
                    rag_trace_record_exception(comp, exc, self.graph)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                raise

            chunks_count = len(arag_response.chunks or [])
            logger.debug("%s Получено %d чанков от ARAG", self._LOG_PREFIX, chunks_count)

            comp.update(
                output=str(arag_response.model_dump()),
                rows_count=chunks_count,
                results_count=chunks_count,
                status="success",
                trace_kind="rag_request",
                rag_type="arag",
            )

            return arag_response

    async def get_response_from_dpa(self) -> DRAResponse:
        alfagen_params = self._get_alfagen_params()
        query_text = self._get_text_value("query_input")
        resolved_system_id = self._resolve_system_id()

        if not query_text:
            raise ValueError("query обязателен")

        logger.debug(
            "%s Запрос к DPA: query_len=%d, channel_app=%s, source_system=%s, user_id=%s",
            self._LOG_PREFIX,
            len(query_text),
            alfagen_params.channel_app,
            resolved_system_id,
            alfagen_params.user_id,
        )

        request = DPARequest(
            query=query_text,
            service_params=BaseRagServiceParams(
                source_system=resolved_system_id,
                channel_app=alfagen_params.channel_app,
                user_id=alfagen_params.user_id,
            ),
        )
        trace_name = "RAG DPA"

        with trace_component(
            trace_name,
            input_data={"query_len": len(query_text)},
            obj=self,
            trace_kind="rag_request",
            rag_type="dpa",
        ) as comp:
            try:
                dpa_response = await self.rag_client.dpa_get_chunk_result(request)
                logger.debug(
                    "%s Успешный ответ от DPA: получено %d чанков, need_operator=%s",
                    self._LOG_PREFIX,
                    len(dpa_response.text or []),
                    dpa_response.need_operator,
                )

                nchunks = len(dpa_response.text or [])
                comp.update(
                    output=str(dpa_response.model_dump()),
                    chunks_count=nchunks,
                    results_count=nchunks,
                    need_operator=dpa_response.need_operator,
                    status="success",
                    trace_kind="rag_request",
                    rag_type="dpa",
                )
            except Exception as exc:
                logger.exception(
                    "%s Ошибка DPA: query_len=%d, channel_app=%s, source_system=%s",
                    self._LOG_PREFIX,
                    len(query_text),
                    alfagen_params.channel_app,
                    resolved_system_id,
                )
                try:
                    rag_trace_record_exception(comp, exc, self.graph)
                except Exception:
                    pass
                raise

        return dpa_response

    def get_rag_json_schema(self) -> Message:
        if self.rag_type == self.RAGTypesEnum.ARAG.value:
            return Message(text=dict_to_pretty_string(ARAGResponse.model_json_schema()))
        if self.rag_type == self.RAGTypesEnum.DPA.value:
            return Message(text=dict_to_pretty_string(DRAResponse.model_json_schema()))
        logger.warning("%s Некорректный rag_type при запросе JSON schema: %s", self._LOG_PREFIX, self.rag_type)
        raise Exception(f"Некорректный rag_type: {self.rag_type}")

    async def get_rag_response(self) -> Message:
        if self.rag_type == self.RAGTypesEnum.ARAG.value:
            rag_response = await self.get_response_from_arag()
        elif self.rag_type == self.RAGTypesEnum.DPA.value:
            rag_response = await self.get_response_from_dpa()
        else:
            raise Exception(f"Некорректный rag_type: {self.rag_type}")

        response_dict = rag_response.model_dump() if hasattr(rag_response, "model_dump") else rag_response

        if self.rag_type == self.RAGTypesEnum.ARAG.value and getattr(self, "strict_formatting", False):
            if "chunks" in response_dict:
                for chunk in response_dict["chunks"]:
                    if "chunk_body" in chunk and "chunk_header" in chunk:
                        chunk["chunk_body"] = chunk["chunk_body"].replace(chunk["chunk_header"], "").strip()

                filtered_chunks = [
                    {k: chunk[k] for k in ("chunk_number", "chunk_header", "chunk_body") if k in chunk}
                    for chunk in response_dict.get("chunks", [])
                    if chunk
                ]
                response_dict = {"chunks": filtered_chunks}

        def fix_markdown_links(text: str) -> str:
            if not isinstance(text, str):
                return text

            def replace_spaces(match: re.Match) -> str:
                link_text, link_url = match.group(1), match.group(2).strip()
                fixed_url = link_url.replace(": ", "://").replace(" ", "/")
                if "://" not in fixed_url:
                    fixed_url = "https://" + fixed_url
                return f"[{link_text}]({fixed_url})"

            return re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+?[\s][^)]*?)\)", replace_spaces, text)

        def recursive_fix(data: Any) -> Any:
            if isinstance(data, str):
                return fix_markdown_links(data)
            if isinstance(data, dict):
                return {k: recursive_fix(v) for k, v in data.items()}
            if isinstance(data, list):
                return [recursive_fix(item) for item in data]
            return data

        response_dict = recursive_fix(response_dict)
        return Message(text=dict_to_pretty_string(response_dict))
